topic: Practical demonstration of steady streamlined flow pattern over object in a smoke tunnel.
syllabus_extract: Practical demonstration of steady streamlined flow pattern over object in a smoke tunnel.
specific_objectives: 6.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to explain the properties of atmosphere, flow over bodies, boundary layer.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Smoke Tunnel Demonstration. Safety: Check electrical connections, ensure smoke fluid is non-toxic, maintain ventilation. Instructor Supervision: Direct observation of flow patterns, immediate correction of misconceptions.
intro_questions: Define steady flow in fluid dynamics.
What is the difference between streamlined and bluff bodies?
How does air behave when it encounters a solid object?

development.content:
Smoke Tunnel Setup and Operation
Steady Streamlined Flow Characteristics
Laminar vs Turbulent Flow Identification

Flow Separation and Wake Formation
Boundary Layer Development Observation
Pressure Distribution Indicators

topics: Effect of Body Shape on Flow
development.content:
Effect of Body Shape on Flow
Streamline Pattern Analysis
Practical Implications for Aircraft

summary_questions: Explain how boundary layer separation affects drag on a bluff body.
Apply your knowledge to predict flow behavior over a sharp-edged vs rounded object.
Why is steady flow important for accurate aerodynamic measurements?
home_assignment_question: Research how the coefficient of lift (CL) changes with angle of attack, preparing for LP 10.

pft_rows.syllabus: Factors affecting CL, Theories of Lift production, force and pitching moment, coefficient of lift, variation of co- efficient of lift with aspect ratio and sweep back and CL.
